(a q : K) (n : ℕ) (alpha beta : ℕ → K)
    (hden : baileyDefined a q n)
    (hpair : ∀ j ≤ n, beta j = baileySum a q alpha j) :
    alpha 0 = beta 0 ∧ (0 < n →
      alpha n = (1-a*q^(2*n)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        poch (a*q) q (n+j-1) * (-1)^(n-j) * q^((n-j)*(n-j-1)/2) /
          poch q q (n-j) * beta j)
